requirements.title: REAL_KINDS lists supported real kinds and has required array shape
requirements.definition: REAL_KINDS is a default integer rank-one array constant whose values are exactly the processor-supported real kind values; its lower bound is one and its size is the number of supported real kinds. Clause 7.4.3.2 requires two or more real approximation methods, and DOUBLE PRECISION has kind KIND(0.0D0) with greater precision than default real.

pending.REAL_KINDS-supported-kind-set: Use REAL_KINDS with concrete probes REAL(KIND=REAL_KINDS(1)), default REAL 0.0, and DOUBLE PRECISION 0.0D0; assert ANY(REAL_KINDS==KIND(0.0)), ANY(REAL_KINDS==KIND(0.0D0)), SIZE(REAL_KINDS)>=2, and generated declarations for each REAL_KINDS element compile. Mutate the array name to LOGICAL_KINDS and mutate the double-precision membership check to a repeated default-real check.
pending.REAL_KINDS-rank-lower-bound-and-size: Assert RANK(REAL_KINDS)==1, LBOUND(REAL_KINDS,1)==1, and SIZE(REAL_KINDS)>=2 using integer sentinels -777 for each observed value. Mutate the expected lower bound to zero and mutate the size lower bound to one.
